proposed_80_20_sequence: Inspect accessible primary procedural chapters and exact examples for sidereal definition, nakshatras, Vimshottari and D9; resolve rights/access gaps with other legitimate sources if needed.
Implement D1 seven classical planets plus explicitly modeled nodes, sidereal ASC, whole-sign houses, Moon nakshatra/pada and sourced sign rulers/dignities.
Add Vimshottari main/subperiods with named year convention and D9. Expose JSON/CLI and label missing interpretations.
Validate positions/ayanamsha independently and compare published worked chart and dasha examples, including boundaries and differing settings. Freeze support/experimental matrix before Core v1 gate.
verification_plan: Independent sidereal positions/ayanamsha fixtures from permitted Swiss/Moshier local reference plus an official or published astronomical source; distinguish shared-model agreement from independent algorithms.
Published worked Moon mansion/pada, Vimshottari balance/transition and D9 examples with complete input/settings and page locators.
0/360, sign/nakshatra/pada boundaries, both hemispheres, DST inputs, node opposition and exact half-open dasha boundaries.
Retain all Western tests and interfaces; different symbolic systems agreeing is not statistical predictive evidence.
rights_policy: Metadata and short original research summaries only. Author-hosted free availability is not assumed to license wholesale translation ingestion or redistribution; no paid books, pirated scans or proprietary implementation code copied.

historical_preimplementation_questions: Choose an exactly defined Lahiri/Chitrapaksha profile after anchor, precession, nutation and mean/true longitude conventions are independently checked. Lahiri-like labels are not interchangeable definitions.
Reuse Skyfield/time/house geometry without changing frozen Western settings; build a separately named sidereal layer only after verification. Never subtract an unverified constant ayanamsha.
Choose a sourced mean-node Rahu/Ketu model for the first slice; true nodes remain a separate option. Existing Western seven-planet calculations alone do not constitute a nine-graha chart.
Keep rashi whole-sign placement separate from bhava/house-cusp methods and divisional charts.
Name Vimshottari year length/time scale and birth-balance calculation; do not reuse Western 360-day releasing units by analogy.
Keep Parashari graha aspects, Jaimini sign aspects, KP sub-lords and their interpretation rules isolated.
